description: This file contains the implementation of the File class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing utility methods for handling files, including verification, path resolution, temporary file creation, and ZIP archive interactions.

classes.name: PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Shared\File
classes.description: Provides static utility functions for file handling, including validation, path resolution, and ZIP archive interactions.

methods.name: setUseUploadTempDirectory
methods.description: Sets a flag to determine whether to use the upload temporary directory for files.

methods.name: getUseUploadTempDirectory
methods.description: Retrieves the current setting for using the upload temporary directory.

methods.name: validateZipFirst4
methods.description: Validates the first four bytes of a ZIP file to verify its magic number.

methods.name: fileExists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists, supporting ZIP archives via 'zip://' streams.

methods.name: realpath
methods.description: Returns the canonical absolute path of a file, handling ZIP archives and relative paths.

methods.name: sysGetTempDir
methods.description: Returns the system's temporary directory, optionally using the upload temp directory if configured.

methods.name: temporaryFilename
methods.description: Creates a temporary filename in the system's temp directory.

methods.name: assertFile
methods.description: Verifies that a file exists and is readable; optionally checks for specific ZIP members.

methods.name: testFileNoThrow
methods.description: Checks if a file and ZIP member exist and are accessible, without throwing exceptions.
